description: For Immediate Release: October 7, 2024 Contact: chandler@april4congress.com Gaithersburg, MD – April McClain Delaney released the following statement following Sunday’s League of Women Voters forum: “Neil Parrott can point fingers, attack me personally and run off the debate stage, but he can’t run away from his repeated attacks against women.” ###
